## Tools this post exists to feed

- [`social-media-link-shortener`](/tools/social-media-link-shortener) - Social Media Link Shortener: The platform’s own short link, where one exists — and a straight answer where it does not.
- [`link-expander`](/tools/link-expander) - Link Expander: See where a short link really goes — every hop, before you click.
- [`youtube-link-shortener`](/tools/youtube-link-shortener) - YouTube Link Shortener: Turn any YouTube link into a clean youtu.be one, timestamp intact.
- [`utm-link-builder`](/tools/utm-link-builder) - UTM Link Builder: Consistent campaign links, so your analytics stay readable.
- [`link-preview-debugger`](/tools/link-preview-debugger) - Link Preview Debugger: What X, Facebook and LinkedIn will show when you share your link.
